page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.8xlarge is a compute-optimized server powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor operates at a baseline frequency of 2.5 GHz and is supported by a 33 MB L3 cache. The system is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a 2.0 GB per core ratio. This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core execution. Single-core processing is a bottleneck, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the weak, bottom 25% category, and single-threaded gzip compression ranking in the bottom 10%. Conversely, the instance leverages its 32 vCPUs to achieve average multi-core performance in the middle 50% tier for stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both cached and uncached reads is average, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

Given its hardware profile, the instance offers moderate qualitative cost efficiency for parallelized workloads that can offset weak single-core speeds through multi-threaded execution. It is suited for multi-threaded decompression, software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations, all of which score in the average tier. It is not recommended for single-threaded tasks or memory-intensive applications requiring high RAM-to-vCPU ratios.
